_about: The answer bank's vocabulary. The big model reads the student's materials once and writes student_profile.json with these keys (only the ones the materials support; never invent). Every value is copied from the materials as written — never translate, transliterate or reconstruct a name, address, date or number from a description or memory. When the materials only describe something, store the description verbatim and flag it in student_profile.md as 待确认. Repeating groups use an index: education[0] is the most recent. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when the day is unknown). Add one-offs under extra.<anything>. This bank feeds BOTH the LaTeX resume generator (resume_compile) and the application-form filler.

keys.name.full_passport_order: Full name as printed in the passport — family name first
keys.name.native_script: Name in the native script (中文姓名)
keys.contact.city: City of residence (as written in the materials)
keys.contact.phone: Full international phone number, country code first (+86 138 1234 5678)
keys.contact.github: GitHub / coding profile URL, if stated
keys.contact.website: Personal website / portfolio URL, if stated
keys.work_authorization: Work authorization / visa status in the target market (e.g. US OPT, H1B, citizen, permanent resident; CN mainland; UK Graduate visa…) — as stated, never assumed
keys.availability: Earliest start date / availability (e.g. 2026-06可到岗; or 2026 Summer)
keys.summary: One or two sentences that position the student for the target roles (derived from materials and agreed with the consultant; never invented facts)
keys.education[i].institution: Education #i: name of the school / university (official English name)
keys.education[i].country: Education #i: country or region of the institution
keys.education[i].level: Education #i: level (high school, bachelor's, master's, doctorate, exchange…)
keys.education[i].degree: Education #i: degree / qualification title (e.g. Bachelor of Science in Computer Science)
keys.education[i].end_date: Education #i: end date or expected graduation date (YYYY-MM, or 'Present')
keys.education[i].rank: Education #i: class rank / percentile, if stated
keys.education[i].courses: Education #i: relevant core courses, comma-separated (from the transcript/course list)
keys.test[i].name: Test #i: name (IELTS, TOEFL, GRE, GMAT, SAT, HSK…)
keys.test[i].subscores: Test #i: sub-scores, e.g. L8.5 R8.5 W6.5 S7.0
keys.experience[i].position: Work or internship #i: job title / position
keys.experience[i].type: Work or internship #i: internship, part-time or full-time
keys.experience[i].country: Work or internship #i: country or region
keys.experience[i].end_date: Work or internship #i: end date (YYYY-MM) or 'Present'
keys.experience[i].bullets: Work or internship #i: bullets, each a quantified achievement — verb starts, numbers included (+40%, 2,000+) — 3-5 of them
keys.project[i].name: Academic / personal project #i: name
keys.project[i].bullets: Academic / personal project #i: bullets (what was built, tech, quantified outcome)
keys.leadership[i].name: Leadership / activity #i: name
keys.skill.technical: Technical skills, comma-separated, grouped as written (Languages: Python, SQL…; Tools: Tableau, Figma…; Frameworks: …)
keys.skill.languages: Languages or certifications with levels (e.g. English IELTS 7.5; Mandarin native)
keys.files.photo: Path of the headshot file in the workspace (if the posting asks for one)
keys.files.cv: Path of an existing CV / résumé in the workspace (exported PDF)
keys.files.cover_letter: Path of a cover letter draft in the workspace
keys.files.portfolio: Path of a portfolio / work sample in the workspace
keys.files.transcript: Path of the academic transcript in the workspace
keys.job_target.roles: Target role types, e.g. ["数据科学实习", "数据分析暑期实习"]
keys.job_target.role_keywords: Keyword tokens to match a posting's title/description, e.g. ["data science", "machine learning", "data analyst"] — 应用两种写法都认（role_keywords / roleKeywords）
keys.job_target.companies: Target / dream companies, if the student named any
keys.job_target.locations: Target locations (countries/cities, e.g. ["United States", "New York", "远程"]
keys.job_target.skills: Skills the target roles need that the student has (used to rank matches)
keys.job_target.location_exclude: 排除地点, 应用两种写法都认 (location_exclude / locationExclude)
keys.job_target.internships_only: 是否只要实习 (true/false), 应用两种写法都认 (internships_only / internshipsOnly)
